summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V., a Dutch clinical-stage RNA-editing company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 9, 2026, announcing that the first healthy volunteer has been dosed in the Phase 1 trial of AX-0811, an AI-discovered RNA editing oligonucleotide targeting NTCP for cholestatic liver diseases including biliary atresia. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appear. The filing also promotes a virtual investor and analyst educational event on September 30, 2026; Phase 1 target engagement data from the first two cohorts are expected in early January 2027. This is a routine clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch pipeline data timing and cash runway rather than deal terms.
